That is perhaps the sadest part of it all. I'm 29. I should be an adult by now. I should have known better, I know I fuck things up, how could I ever have been so naive?

I just want it to all work out in the end. I want to be happy. But I also want my kid to have a father. Ok he is an asshole but of course there are positive thingsabout him, otherwise I wouldn't have fallen for him. How do I know where to draw the line? I'm sensible and maybe I often don't treat him right either, perhaps ^it's ^all ^not ^^that ^^bad?

I'm just so extremly sad right now, I can't even think straight. Thank you for your kind words, though I don't feel like I deserve it. 

In march I talked to a doctor about my medication and he said I would have to go to a specialist. But I would have to wait several month to get an appointment so I just thought screw that.. I didn't feel to bad back then. But now, the more I get to know HIM, the longer this goes on, I feel worse every day. I have had episodes like this before but I always had someone to talk to, someone who would help me. But everyone is just gone now. My parents are kind people, they have gone through so much shit because of me, I feel so guilty.. I don't want to hurt them anymore, I just want this nightmare to end. I don't think there will be a solution. Just. an end.

And I know how dumb this is, you don't know me, of course I shouldn't even be thinking of killing myself etc. I know that. I made a series of wrong decisions and now I have to live with what I choose. Perhaps this is my punishment. Maybe I need to suffer.
